# load dependencies
```{r,message=FALSE}
library(cocoframer)
library(igraph)
library(ggraph)
```


# retreive the structure ontology
```{r,message=FALSE}
o <- get_mba_ontology()
o <- flatten_mba_ontology(o)
o <- generate_taxons(o)
```


# display the ontology
```{r}
g <- graph_from_data_frame(o[c("parent_structure_id","id")] |> na.exclude(),vertices = o)
ggraph(g,"tree",circular=TRUE) + 
  geom_edge_link(color="lightgrey") + 
  geom_node_text(aes(label=acronym,color=paste0("#",color_hex_triplet)),size=3) + 
  scale_color_identity() +
  coord_equal()
```


# get reference volume annotations
```{r}
A <- get_ccf_grid_annotation()
```



# Display SS mesh
```{r}
rgl::clear3d()
plot_ccf_meshes(list(
  a=ccf_2017_mesh("root"),
  b=ccf_2017_mesh("HIP")
),c("b"),bg_structure="a",fg_alpha = 0.4)
rgl::rgl.viewpoint(-40,phi = 50)
rgl::rglwidget()
```

# Check alignment with annotation cube
```{r}
local({
  sub <- filter_mba_ontology_children(o,"HIP",include_parent = TRUE)
  pos <- reshape2::melt(A) |>
    subset(value %in% sub$id)
  a <- 200;rgl::plot3d((pos$Var1-1)*a,(ncol(A)-pos$Var2)*a,(pos$Var3-1)*a,add = TRUE)
})
rgl::rglwidget()
```




# Retreive volumes of some marker genes
```{r}
V <- list(
  Sox10 =get_aba_ish_data(get_gene_aba_ish_ids("Sox10")),
  Lhx9 = get_aba_ish_data(get_gene_aba_ish_ids("Lhx9")),
  Pvalb = get_aba_ish_data(get_gene_aba_ish_ids("Pvalb")[[1]]),
  Calb1 = get_aba_ish_data(get_gene_aba_ish_ids("Calb1")[[1]])
)
```


# Display location of expressed markers
```{r}
local({
  pos <- Reduce('&',Map('>',V,10)) |> reshape2::melt() |>
    merge(reshape2::melt(A),by=1:3) |>
    subset(value.x>0) |>
    subset(value.y>0)
  pos$Var3_abs <- 29.5 + abs(pos$Var3 - 29.5)
  
  rgl::clear3d()
  plot_ccf_meshes(list(
      a=ccf_2017_mesh("root"),
      b=ccf_2017_mesh("CB")
    ),c("b"),bg_structure="a",fg_alpha = 0.4)
  a <- 200;rgl::plot3d((pos$Var1-1)*a,(ncol(A)-pos$Var2)*a,(pos$Var3_abs-1)*a,add = TRUE)  
})
rgl::rglwidget()
```
